note: Editorial topic plan for the three submitted Amazon links. Every topic is built only on facts that appear in the Amazon listing text or in Amazon's own programme documents, and every row carries the official source of the fact it rests on. No topic is described as trending, popular, high-converting or in demand: no official Amazon endpoint publishes search volume, keyword difficulty, trend direction or conversion rate to affiliates (FLG-033), so no such claim is made here. Topic titles are working SEO titles, not published article titles.
method: Read the destination listing for each submitted link and take the facts straight from the listing title.
Ask which reader question that fact actually answers, and write the working title for that question.

Check the claim against the rules this site works under: prices and ratings need an Amazon-served link or API data (2(b), 6(t)), no first-hand experience may be described (FTC), no link may obscure the Amazon destination (6(w)), no Redirecting Link may be used (CIS 2(e)).
If a topic needs a number this build cannot source, the topic still ships — the number is withheld and the rule is stated.

statuses.ready: Ready to draft: every fact it needs is on an Amazon page and linked below.
statuses.blocked: Draftable only once the product identity is confirmed (FLG-002, FLG-027, FLG-035). The facts are verified; what they describe may not be the product the requester meant.

topics.title: Air Fryer Oven vs. Countertop Air Fryer: Which One Feeds a Family of Six?
topics.angle: The three listings span 6, 8 and 26 quarts, so the capacity question is the first thing a reader asks. The answer comes from the listing titles.
topics.facts: P1 is a 6 Quart dual-basket air fryer oven; P2 is a 26QT air fryer toaster oven with French doors; P3 is an 8 Qt single-basket air fryer. All three sit under the same Amazon browse path: Home & Kitchen › Kitchen & Dining › Small Appliances › Fryers › Air Fryers.

must_not_state.text: a price, a discount, or a best-seller position for any of the three
must_not_state.rule: Participation Requirement 2(b) and 6(t); the category benchmark is point-in-time only (FLG-022, FLG-025)

topics.title: Dual-Basket Air Fryers: Cooking Two Foods at Once, One Basket at a Time
topics.angle: Only one of the three listings describes two independent baskets and a sync-finish control, so it is the natural subject of its own article.
topics.facts: The P1 listing title describes a CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven with two independent 3Qt nonstick dishwasher-safe frying baskets, a Sync Finish control, easy-view windows, a Hi-Fry option, auto shutoff and a digital double air fryer.

must_not_state.text: that the two baskets cook faster than a single-basket oven, or that Sync Finish synchronises anything it does not name in the title
must_not_state.rule: Participation Requirement 2(b): no inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product

topics.title: Air Fryer Toaster Oven With French Doors: What 24 Cooking Functions Actually Adds
topics.angle: One listing is a multi-function air fryer toaster oven with a rotisserie and a dual-speed fan, which is a different purchase decision from a basket fryer.
topics.facts: The P2 listing title describes an Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door Multi-Function Air Fryer Toaster Oven with 24 cooking functions, a dual-speed fan and a rotisserie, for family meals.

must_not_state.text: a cook time, a serving size or a performance comparison the listing title does not state
must_not_state.rule: FTC: you cannot talk about your experience with a product you have not tried, and no claim may need proof the advertiser does not have

topics.title: 4-in-1 Air Fryers: Bake, Dehydrate and Cook From Frozen in One Basket
topics.angle: The 8-quart listing is the only one whose title names baking, dehydrating and cooking from frozen, so the multi-function angle is specific to it.
topics.facts: The P3 listing title describes a Chefman Air Fryer 8 Qt with a TurboFry 4-in-1 function, a 450°F Hi-Fry option, and a bake / dehydrate / frozen basket set, with an XL nonstick dishwasher-safe basket in stainless steel.

must_not_state.text: that the appliance dehydrates meat or that it reaches 450°F in a particular time
must_not_state.rule: no claim about performance that the listing does not make (Participation Requirement 2(b))

topics.title: Dishwasher-Safe Air Fryer Baskets: What the Listing Says, and What It Does Not
topics.angle: Two of the three titles name dishwasher-safe baskets. A short, honest explainer of what a basket-cleaning claim does and does not cover is useful, and needs no numbers.
topics.facts: The P1 title names two independent 3Qt nonstick dishwasher-safe frying baskets; the P3 title names an XL nonstick dishwasher-safe basket. Nothing further about cleaning is stated in either title.

must_not_state.text: dishwasher cycle, temperature or detergent advice that the listing does not state
must_not_state.rule: Participation Requirement 2(b): no misleading Product claims

topics.title: How to Read an Amazon Air Fryer Listing: Six Facts That Decide the Purchase
topics.angle: A method article: name the six facts that can be read from a listing title - form factor, capacity, functions, cleaning, controls and the browse path - and show how the three listings differ.
topics.facts: Form factor, stated capacity, named functions, cleaning, controls and category position are all readable from the three listing titles and from the Amazon browse path Home & Kitchen › Kitchen & Dining › Small Appliances › Fryers › Air Fryers (browse node 17659096011).

must_not_state.text: a star rating or a review quote to illustrate the method
must_not_state.rule: Participation Requirement 6(t): customer reviews and star ratings may be used only if obtained through Creators API or PA API

topics.title: Where Air Fryers Sit in Amazon's Category Tree - and Why the Category Decides Your Commission Rate
topics.angle: Amazon's published rate table is by product category, and all three listings sit in the Air Fryers node. This explains, in the publisher's own words, how a category rate becomes a rate.
topics.facts: All three destination listings sit under Home & Kitchen › Kitchen & Dining › Small Appliances › Fryers › Air Fryers. Amazon's Standard Commission Income Statement Table 1 lists the row "Physical Books, Kitchen, Automotive" at 4.50% and "All Other Categories" at 4.00%. The table is by category, not by product.

must_not_state.text: a per-product commission rate or a commission income figure for any of the three listings
must_not_state.rule: the published table fixes rates by category; the listings' commission category and the account's own rate card are not established here (FLG-005, FLG-021, FLG-031)

topics.title: Best-Selling Air Fryers Right Now: A Point-in-Time Amazon Category Snapshot
topics.angle: Amazon publishes one official ranking surface for this category. It is the only source on this site that may be called a popularity snapshot, and it changes between captures.
topics.facts: Amazon's Best Sellers page for browse node 17659096011 lists the leading Air Fryers listings by position. The positions read on 2026-11-14 differ from the positions read on 2026-11-13, so any article using it must date the snapshot.

must_not_state.text: a rank for the three submitted listings, or the rank without the date it was read
must_not_state.rule: ranks are point-in-time and move between captures (FLG-025); a rank for a specific product is not published by any affiliate endpoint

topics.title: What an Amazon Affiliate Link Has to Look Like - and Why a Short Link Can Earn Nothing
topics.angle: The single most useful trust article for this site: a Special Link must carry the Associates tag in the URL, a link that sends a visitor indirectly to Amazon without an affirmative click can disqualify the purchase, and a link shortener that obscures the Amazon destination is restricted.
topics.facts: Participation Requirement 2(b): "you must include your Associates ID or 'tag' (appearing as XXXXX-##...) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site". Commission Income Statement 2(e): a purchase is disqualified when the customer is "referred to an Amazon Site by a link that sends users indirectly to an Amazon Site via an intermediate site, without requiring the customer to click on a link or take some other affirmative action on that intermediate site (a 'Redirecting Link')". Requirement 6(w): you will not use a link shortening service "in a manner that makes it unclear that you are linking to an Amazon Site".

must_not_state.text: that a specific short link has been tested in a logged-in Associates account
must_not_state.rule: the account test has not been run; the policy text is the only thing this site can state (FLG-003)

topics.title: What You Are Allowed to Say About a Product You Have Not Used
topics.angle: A disclosure and honesty article: what the FTC requires, what Amazon requires, and why this site states no price, no rating and no first-hand experience on any product page.
topics.facts: The FTC states that you cannot talk about your experience with a product you have not tried, and that a disclosure should be placed so it is hard to miss. The Operating Agreement requires the statement "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases." clearly and prominently wherever Program Content appears, and treats a breach of that section as a material breach of the Agreement.

must_not_state.text: that the site or its owner has used, tested or owned any of the three products
must_not_state.rule: FTC: you cannot talk about your experience with a product you have not tried

topics.title: Air Fryer, Toaster Oven, Convection Oven: Choosing by the Job, Not by the Feature List
topics.angle: A decision article that stays inside the Amazon category: it compares the three listings on the job each one does, using only the functions named in each title.
topics.facts: Named functions by listing: P1 - two independent baskets, Sync Finish, Hi-Fry, auto shutoff; P2 - 24 cooking functions, dual-speed fan, rotisserie, French doors; P3 - TurboFry 4-in-1, 450°F Hi-Fry, bake, dehydrate, frozen.

must_not_state.text: a comparison with a non-Amazon retailer's product
must_not_state.rule: Participation Requirement 6(z): do not use Program Content to advertise or promote products offered on any site that is not an Amazon Site

topics.title: Ten Things to Check Before You Buy Any Air Fryer Online - A Checklist Built From Three Real Listings
topics.angle: A checklist that earns links without a single unverifiable number: capacity, basket count, functions, temperature range as stated, cleaning, controls, category, disclosure, price checking and the buyer's own use case.
topics.facts: Each checklist line is answerable from the three listing titles and from Amazon's own rules: what the listing states (title), the category path (browse node 17659096011), how a price may legally be shown (2(b)), which ratings may be shown (6(t)), and what a disclosure must say (Operating Agreement Section 5).

must_not_state.text: a recommendation, a winner or a star rating to close the checklist
must_not_state.rule: no earnings or performance promise, and no rating without API data (6(t))
